title: Polish Grave Accord first-time play and multiplayer
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
The public-only contest version is published at https://grave-accord.yigallin0423.chatgpt.site (Sites version 1, game source 71fc34cfd88a245d7003f16df7a7dc5e90986410/protocol 43). The matching Free multiplayer service at https://grave-accord-contest.onrender.com has eight slots/one room, auto-deploy off and actual hosted room/password/chat/host/record checks. Testing tools are excluded from public client and worker.

Equipment and skills have distinct painted empty-state images; the shop/HUD use matching coins and skill-point artwork with labels. Shared-IP request budgets support group joins/retries while keeping wrong-code guesses bounded. Own-result roster pages are reused only in their active filters, and duplicate/wrong-difficulty shortcut rows are prevented. Redundant client schema serialization is removed with all wire/build fields checked against real seven-class peers.

943/943 local tests and both complete exact-source CI jobs 124387637908/124387593747 pass. Fresh 8/16/50 real-SDK mixed progression passes with protected QA players/accelerated clears, including votes, host transfer, replacement, reconnect and restart persistence. Local public/testing share 1697 identical files and both pass 52 served hashes/15 catalogs plus real two-peer checks. All 1902 files match across original/extracted/independent Japanese-path local Windows copies before/after six native offline/LAN diagnostics. That local ZIP is 848387334 bytes/SHA256 4a8f24625c3e8d39327156c6fd9198e67a0341ad8ad509bfab52e8691c7eb0a0; the public Windows download is not replaced.

The final Site archive fits the upload limit by retaining 67 compressed primary tracks/all sound effects and using pinned original-WAV fallback URLs. All 18 compiled scripts match the prior public build after reversing only 67 fallback URL substitutions. Thirty-five live HTTP samples pass strict asset/MIME checks and normalized HTML checks for a known Cloudflare injection.

Handoff: handoff/contest-checkpoint-2026-10-30 and its checksum-verified ZIP contain publication identities, accepted policies, lessons, source/hosted/native evidence and deferred post-contest ideas. This remains a draft; main is not merged. No current rendered/human/device/listening/native-language/balance/full endurance or larger WAN-host capacity acceptance is claimed. Free-host SQLite records are ephemeral across sleep/restart/redeploy; durable global storage remains future work. The old Site/backend and all failed/art/native artifacts remain separate. No automatic post-contest feature work.
